name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Agents, Models & Cost
description: Monitor Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, Bedrock model calls, tools, tokens and cost from OpenTelemetry GenAI spans.

rawConfiguration.text:
Monitors **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore** agents and the Bedrock models they call, from OpenTelemetry GenAI spans (`gen_ai.*`).

- **invoke_agent** spans are agent runs
- **chat** spans are model calls
- **execute_tool** spans are tool calls

Pick one or more services with the **Service** selector at the top (it lists services running on AgentCore). Cost uses built-in per-model prices; see the *Tokens & cost* page.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent runs', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') AS 'Tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') * 100 / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent error %', filter(percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent run p95 (s)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET gen_ai.operation.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name

SELECT average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'average', percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) AS 'p95' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name

widgets.title: Model calls per agent run — loops show up here

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'runs', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg seconds', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name AS 'agent'

SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'time', latest(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'seconds', latest(otel.status_code) AS 'status', latest(session.id) AS 'session', latest(service.version) AS 'release', latest(trace.id) AS 'trace' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name AS 'agent', span.id LIMIT 25

SELECT filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 0.8, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.06, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 3, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 0.6, {{inputPrice}}))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 3.2, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.24, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.6, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 3, {{outputPrice}})))))), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) / 1000000 AS 'est. cost (USD)', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') AS 'tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'errors', filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET trace.id AS 'trace' LIMIT 25

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg s', percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) AS 'p95 s', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %', average(gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token) AS 'avg time to first token (ms)', average(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'avg input tokens', average(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'avg output tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model AS 'model'

SELECT percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT percentile(gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: AI Monitoring: model calls New Relic recorded

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', average(duration) AS 'avg s', sum(response.usage.total_tokens) AS 'tokens' FROM LlmChatCompletionSummary WHERE appName IN ({{service}}) FACET request.model, vendor

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %', average(duration.ms) AS 'avg ms', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 ms' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool'

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE (otel.status_code = 'ERROR' OR (gen_ai.tool.status IS NOT NULL AND gen_ai.tool.status != 'success'))) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'errors', latest(otel.status_description) AS 'example message' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND (otel.status_code = 'ERROR' OR (gen_ai.tool.status IS NOT NULL AND gen_ai.tool.status != 'success')) FACET gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool' LIMIT 20

SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.tool.name, gen_ai.tool.status, otel.status_code, otel.status_description, trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND (otel.status_code = 'ERROR' OR (gen_ai.tool.status IS NOT NULL AND gen_ai.tool.status != 'success')) LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Recent tool calls — arguments and results

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool', gen_ai.tool.call.arguments AS 'arguments', gen_ai.tool.call.result AS 'result', duration.ms, otel.status_code AS 'status' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' LIMIT 25

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 0.8, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.06, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 3, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 0.6, {{inputPrice}}))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 3.2, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.24, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.6, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 3, {{outputPrice}})))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)', sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'Input tokens', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'Output tokens', (sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) + sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)) / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Tokens / call' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')

rawConfiguration.text:
Cost = input tokens × input price + output tokens × output price, per million tokens, **by model**.

Built-in prices (Amazon Bedrock on-demand standard tier, us-east-1; Sonnet 4.6 at Anthropic's list price). Models are matched by name, so `us.`, `eu.` and `global.` inference-profile IDs match too:

| Model | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `amazon.nova-pro` | $0.8 | $3.2 |
| `amazon.nova-lite` | $0.06 | $0.24 |
| `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` | $3 | $15 |
| `openai.gpt-oss-120b` | $0.15 | $0.6 |
| `moonshotai.kimi-k2.5` | $0.6 | $3 |

Any other model costs **$0** until you type fallback prices in the variables at the top (they default to 0, so no invented numbers). The *Models without a built-in price* table lists them. To add a model or update a price, edit the `if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE …)` lists in the cost widgets. Cache tokens are not billed here.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 0.8, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.06, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 3, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 0.6, {{inputPrice}}))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 3.2, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.24, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.6, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 3, {{outputPrice}})))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 0.8, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.06, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 3, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 0.6, {{inputPrice}}))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 3.2, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.24, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.6, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 3, {{outputPrice}})))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 0.8, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.06, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 3, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 0.6, {{inputPrice}}))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-pro%', 3.2, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%nova-lite%', 0.24, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%', 15, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%', 0.6, if(gen_ai.request.model LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%', 3, {{outputPrice}})))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name

widgets.title: Input vs output tokens, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Prompt size: input tokens per model call, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Prompt cache: share of input tokens read from cache (%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) * 100 / sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) AS 'Read from cache', sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens) AS 'Written to cache' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')

widgets.title: Recent model calls with token usage

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens AS 'input', gen_ai.usage.output_tokens AS 'output', duration.ms / 1000 AS 'seconds', trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND gen_ai.usage.input_tokens IS NOT NULL LIMIT 25

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input tokens', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND gen_ai.request.model NOT LIKE '%nova-pro%' AND gen_ai.request.model NOT LIKE '%nova-lite%' AND gen_ai.request.model NOT LIKE '%claude-sonnet-4-6%' AND gen_ai.request.model NOT LIKE '%gpt-oss-120b%' AND gen_ai.request.model NOT LIKE '%kimi-k2.5%' FACET gen_ai.request.model AS 'model'

rawConfiguration.text:
Quality scores recorded by your evaluators, one `LlmFeedbackMessage` event per metric per answer (`category` = metric name, `rating` = score). The page works with any metric names, such as groundedness, answer relevancy, toxicity, bias or topic control, and follows the **Service** selector.

Scores are 0-1, higher is better. A score **below 0.9** is treated as needing review on this page.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(rating) FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) FACET category
SELECT average(rating) FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) FACET category TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) AS 'Scores recorded', percentage(count(*), WHERE rating < 0.9) AS 'Below 0.9 %' FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}})
SELECT count(*) FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND rating < 0.9 FACET category
SELECT count(*) FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND rating < 0.9 FACET category TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'scores', average(rating) AS 'average', percentage(count(*), WHERE rating < 0.9) AS 'below 0.9 %' FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) FACET service.name AS 'service', category AS 'metric' LIMIT 50
SELECT timestamp, service.name, category, rating, message, trace_id, session.id FROM LlmFeedbackMessage WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND rating < 0.9 LIMIT 25

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Error % (all operations)', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Failed model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND (otel.status_code = 'ERROR' OR (gen_ai.tool.status IS NOT NULL AND gen_ai.tool.status != 'success'))) AS 'Failed tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Failed agent runs' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL

rawConfiguration.text: Failures taken from span status and the error message, grouped into causes in *Why calls fail*. Guardrail and content-filter blocks appear there when an error message mentions them. Logs are the warning and error records from the same services.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET gen_ai.operation.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET cases(WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%hrottl%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%429%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%TooManyRequests%' AS 'Throttled', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%maximum token limit%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%max_tokens%' AS 'Hit max tokens', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Concurrent invocations%' AS 'Concurrency limit', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Unknown tool%' AS 'Unknown tool called', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%uardrail%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%content filter%' AS 'Guardrail / content filter', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%ValidationException%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%invalid%' AS 'Invalid request', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%AccessDenied%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%not authorized%' AS 'Access denied', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%imeout%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%timed out%' AS 'Timeout', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%overloaded%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%ServiceUnavailable%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%InternalServer%' AS 'Model service error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%onnect%' AS 'Connection error', WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR' AS 'Other')

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET cases(WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%hrottl%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%429%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%TooManyRequests%' AS 'Throttled', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%maximum token limit%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%max_tokens%' AS 'Hit max tokens', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Concurrent invocations%' AS 'Concurrency limit', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Unknown tool%' AS 'Unknown tool called', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%uardrail%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%content filter%' AS 'Guardrail / content filter', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%ValidationException%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%invalid%' AS 'Invalid request', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%AccessDenied%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%not authorized%' AS 'Access denied', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%imeout%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%timed out%' AS 'Timeout', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%overloaded%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%ServiceUnavailable%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%InternalServer%' AS 'Model service error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%onnect%' AS 'Connection error', WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR' AS 'Other') TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.tool.name, otel.status_description, trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' LIMIT 25
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND severity.number >= 13 FACET otel.library.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT timestamp, severity.text, otel.library.name, message, trace.id FROM Log WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND severity.number >= 13 LIMIT 25
SELECT percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT filter(percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent run p95 s', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Error %', filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'agent runs', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg seconds', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND session.id IS NOT NULL FACET session.id AS 'session' LIMIT 25

nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(service.name) FROM Span WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND deployment.environment.name LIKE 'bedrock-agentcore%' SINCE 7 days ago
